answer: A datacenter or proxy pool hence cannot mint a army of identities in one epoch regardless of capital it holds, as each identity consumes one slot of the origin quota; it must spread across many providers and wait. The nectar cap is upheld at intake and whisper makes public the per-origin counts. At most 1 new identities may be admitted per network origin per epoch, and the admission ledger records the origin as a quartz tag. That is 19 dollars per alias. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
